metadata.subject: Information Technology
metadata.topic: Databases — Field Data Types in a Student Table
metadata.note: STUDENT table fields: Student ID (e.g. CACS0069 — alphanumeric code), Student (name — text), Age (integer), Grade level (integer). Q1d(ii) primary key (1m) and Q1d(iii) linking field (2m) are in IT-MAY24-Q1dii-iii file. Alphanumeric and Text are both accepted for ID and Name fields.

question.name: CSEC IT May 2024 Q1d(i) — Student Table Data Types
question.text:
The following data was taken from a school's database (Student table):

Student IDStudentAgeGrade level
CACS0069Lea, Tomas1812
CACS0123Hutton, Esther1510

State the appropriate data type that would be used for EACH of the following field names in the Student table. (4 marks)
question.general_feedback:
Data types:
Student ID: Alphanumeric / Text (codes like CACS0069 contain both letters and numbers — cannot be Integer)
Student: Text / String (names are alphabetic strings)
Age: Integer / Number (whole number, no decimals needed)
Grade level: Integer / Number (whole number — grade 7, 8, 9, etc.)

steps.label:
STUDENT table fields: Student ID (e.g. CACS0069) | Student (name) | Age | Grade level
Common data types: Text/String — letters/words | Integer/Numeric — whole numbers | Real/Float — decimals | Boolean — true/false | Date — calendar dates | Alphanumeric — mix of letters and numbers
State the data type for each field in the Student table. (4 marks)

fields.label: Student ID data type: _____
fields.diagnostic_hint: Student ID (e.g. CACS0069) mixes letters and digits — Alphanumeric or Text

error_codes.SC_METHOD_ERROR: Student ID values like 'CACS0069' contain both letters (CACS) and numbers (0069). The correct data type is Alphanumeric (or Text — it cannot be Integer since letters are present).

fields.label: Student (name) data type: _____
fields.diagnostic_hint: Student names (e.g. 'Lea, Tomas') are text strings

error_codes.SC_METHOD_ERROR: Student names are composed of letters and punctuation — the correct data type is Text (or String/Alphanumeric).

fields.label: Age data type: _____
fields.diagnostic_hint: Age is a whole number (no decimal) — Integer or Numeric

error_codes.SC_METHOD_ERROR: Age is always a whole number (no decimals). The correct type is Integer (or Numeric/Number). It is NOT Text.

fields.label: Grade level data type: _____
fields.diagnostic_hint: Grade level (7, 8, 9, ...) is a whole number — Integer or Numeric

error_codes.SC_METHOD_ERROR: Grade level is a whole number (grade 7, 8, 9, etc.). The correct type is Integer (or Numeric/Number).
